title: feat(spec,ui): an object declares when a whole record is read-only by hand (object-level uiReadonlyWhen)
body:
Fixes #37402

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：作者可以在对象上写一句「状态为已确认或已完成时整单人手锁定」，控制台的编辑对话框、记录页、表格、看板、日历、甘特图和工时表都改不了这条记录；备注这类字段可单独放开；按钮、接口、导入、流程照常写入。
- 为什么做：父卡「字段只能通过动作修改」的裁决「按长远模型」把对象级这一半一并定下；确认后的订单、已过账的发票要整单锁，逐字段写条件容易漏。
- 出错会怎样：漏掉某个界面入口时用户仍能手改，数据仍由校验规则兜底；去掉对象上的这一句即可撤回。「复制记录取默认值」一项控制台目前没有复制入口，本次未建，见下文。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Governing ruling (on #36806, 2026-11-26, the card's governing text, quoted): 「按长远模型」 — two tiers (server lock `readonly`/`readonlyWhen`; hand lock `uiReadonly`/`uiReadonlyWhen`) × two levels (field, object); a field's own declaration wins over the object default; write paths keep every write (the engine never reads the key). ADR-0085 §2 (the object-level key names the console as a whole, not a page) and ADR-0049 (a declared key is enforced on every surface it names).

**Spec (`packages/spec`)**
- `ObjectSchema.uiReadonlyWhen` — optional CEL predicate over the record's own columns (`EvaluatedExpressionInputSchema`, the field key's scope), with TSDoc and describe. No default, so no parsed object grows a key.
- Liveness row `object.uiReadonlyWhen` (live); Studio object form row (Advanced section, CEL code row); regenerated reference docs, authorable-surface record (`data/Object:uiReadonlyWhen`) and state counts.

**Console (`ui/packages/**`) — item 3, one helper, no surface reads the key**
- `@object-ui/core` `handLock.ts`: `effectiveUiReadonlyWhen(def, object)` — the field's own `uiReadonlyWhen` when the field declares a hand lock of its own — `uiReadonly: true` or a `uiReadonlyWhen` — else the object's. `uiReadonly: false` is **not** a declaration of its own: it reads as absent and the field follows the object lock (seat ruling on the card, Q1 = B; the one opt-out spelling is `uiReadonlyWhen: P\`false\``). `fieldLockPredicates(def, object)` for operand fetches. `fieldReadOnlyByHand(def, record, { object, … })` and `fieldHasConditionalHandLock(def, object)` take the object **as a required argument**, so the compiler asks every caller for it (these helpers are not on npm yet: the newest published `@object-ui/core` is `19.0.0-next.0`, and they first ship in `next.1`).
- Every caller passes the object: record page (`DetailSection`, `HeaderHighlight`, `InlineEditSaveBar`, stage path), grid cell (`cellReadOnlyKind` gains a required `object`), kanban drop, calendar drop, Gantt write gate (`ganttPatchByHand` takes the object), timesheet cell.
- The direct `resolveFieldRuleState` callers read the folded predicate from the producer, not the object: the edit dialog's form fields (`sectionFields.fromObjectSchema`, `ObjectForm`) carry `effectiveUiReadonlyWhen(...)`, so `form.tsx` and `WizardForm` (which judge what a form field carries) fold the object lock **with no change of their own**; `editFormLockedByState` folds it the same way; line-item columns (`deriveMasterDetail`, derived and authored) carry the CHILD object's predicate, which `GridFieldWidget` already judges per row.
- Operand fetches: the grid's own row load and the list view's `$select` fetch the object predicate's operands for every inheriting column / edited-in-place field.

**Server**
- Engine untouched (item 6): nothing under `packages/objectql/**` reads the key.
- MCP `describe_object` (item 5) reports the object's `uiReadonlyWhen` text at the answer's top level where authored, on HTTP (`runtime/domains/mcp.ts`) and stdio (`mcp/mcp-server-runtime.ts`); the tool description says how to read it.
- FLS scrub (`metadata-core`): an object predicate that reads a field denied to the caller is served as the constant `true` (fail-closed, the field-level precedent: deleting it would open every record for exactly that caller).
- `os validate` (`lint`): the object slot is checked as the field slot is (record-scoped check + root verdict), at `object 'NAME' uiReadonlyWhen`.
- Studio form row translated in all 11 metadata-forms locale packs (`platform-objects`); translated-leaf pin 845 → 846.

## Why

A whole-record lock (confirmed order, posted invoice) had to be written as a `uiReadonlyWhen` on every field — tedious, and one missed field leaves a hand edit open. The ruling adopted the object level now.

### Item 4 (console duplicate) — no surface, not delivered

Measured on `f72f3353`: no person-triggered record duplicate exists in the console. Searched `ui/packages` and `ui/apps` for `duplicate|clone|onClone|cloneRecord|data.clone(`: the hits are the view switcher's view actions, Studio package/sharing-rule/permission-set clones, an unused `detail.duplicate` translation string, and the spec capability flag `enable.clone`. The only record clone is the REST door `POST /data/:object/:id/clone` (`rest/data-action-routes.ts` → `cloneData`), reached by the SDK's `data.clone` — an API write, which by the ruling keeps every value. Item 4 is reported as **"no surface — not delivered"** and nothing was built; the done-when clause "duplicating the confirmed record yields a record whose `status` is the field's `defaultValue`" has no surface to hold on. The rule is carried by #38202 as the acceptance of a future console Duplicate action (seat ruling on the card, Q3). `Fixes #37402` stands.

## Tests

- `@object-ui/core` `handLock-36806.test.ts` (new top-level describe): object lock locks a non-declaring field while TRUE and only then; `uiReadonlyWhen: 'false'` (string and envelope) keeps a field editable; a field's own predicate / `uiReadonly: true` locks where the object does not (override both directions); explicit `uiReadonly: false` is NOT a declaration — the field follows the object lock (Q1 = B), with a CONTROL that `uiReadonlyWhen: 'false'` (alone or beside `uiReadonly: false`) still opens it; server lock does not cancel the object default; fail-closed on a faulted / operand-less object predicate; the fold helpers.
- `plugin-form` `dialogHandLock-36806.test.ts`: dialog form fields carry the object predicate / the field's own; line-item columns (derived and authored) carry the child object's.
- `app-shell` `editFormLockedByState.test.ts`: object lock greys Edit; a `false` override keeps it live; off while the predicate does not hold.
- `plugin-grid`: cell verdict over the object lock and its override; the row load `$select` asks for the object predicate's operand and not for a column with its own lock.
- `plugin-kanban`: a drop on a record the object locks writes nothing; a lane field with its own `false` writes the move.
- `lint`: object slot accepted / bare reference / parse / undeclared field / unbound root refused (each authoring refusal has a test); read-surface pin gains `uiReadonlyWhen`.
- `metadata-core`: denied operand → served `'true'` (string and envelope); readable → served as written.
- `mcp` stdio and `runtime` HTTP `describe_object`: the object predicate is reported; no field's `readonly` changes; a stored `uiReadonly: false` lists no hand-lock key; an object without it carries no key.
- Dogfood (`ui-readonly-hand-lock-36806.dogfood.test.ts`, new top-level describe on one shared boot): the done-when object (`state_machine` on `status`, object `uiReadonlyWhen: P\`record.status in ['confirmed','done']\``, `notes` `P\`false\``); the served definition carries both predicates; a PATCH to a confirmed record lands with **no `X-ObjectStack-Dropped-Fields`**; an import update writes and the machine still refuses an illegal move; a declarative action writes.

## Acceptance notes

- Seat rulings on the card's three open questions (newest seat comment on #37402): Q1 = B, maintainer verbatim 「B 不算放开」 — implemented in head `696c37e9` (`declaresOwnHandLock`, the pin flipped, every describe / help / liveness / changeset / `describe_object` string names the two counting spellings; help retranslated in 10 locales). Q2 = A, kept as built. Q3: item 4 closes as "no surface — not delivered", carried by #38202.

- `requiredWhen` prompt collector (`fields/requiredWhenPrompt.ts`) keeps reading the field's own key: the hosts' `fillable` callbacks already judge the object lock over the STORED record, which is the right record for a transition the person is still allowed to make.
- The public intake form page (`ui/apps/console` `FormPage.tsx`) is create-only and never carried a hand lock; untouched.
- A parent's object lock does not lock its child line-item rows: those rows are records of the child object and follow the child object's own lock.
- The grid cell judges with the grid's own fetched object definition; while that read is in flight the cell sees no object lock (the same window the host field catalogue already has).
- `objectExtensions` does not gain the key (not asked).

## Verification

Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/evaluator/__tests__/handLock-36806.test.ts` — expect the `#37402` describe green (7 cases).

First files to read (by risk): `ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/handLock.ts` (the fold and its override rule); `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/sectionFields.ts` (how the edit dialog gets the object lock without `form.tsx` reading it); `packages/metadata-core/src/object-schema-fls-references.ts` (`objectHandLock`, the fail-closed serve).

Q1 re-verification on head `696c37e9` (no conflict with `origin/main`, so no merge): ui hand-lock files 5/5 (49 tests); ablation restoring the old rule (`uiReadonly !== undefined` counts) turns the flipped pin red (1 failed / 14 passed), restore blob == HEAD; mcp `mcp-server-runtime.test.ts` 20/20, runtime describe 5/5; typecheck mcp, runtime and `@object-ui/core` type-check 0; `spec check:liveness` 0; `spec check:generated` all 14 up to date; `check:i18n` 0, `check:i18n-stale-fill` OK; platform-objects 130 files / 2,214; overlap-check clean. The derived gate union on `696c37e9` is reported in the card's delta os-dev-report.

Verification record (first head) — every reading below is taken on `objectstack-ai/objectstack` at head `0bee2a81` (the branch after merging `origin/main` at `0e361201`) unless it says otherwise; locked runs went through `os-verify-lock.sh`.
